title: Concept: Python requirement fetched from a direct URL
description: requirements.txt declares a requirement that points at a wheel or sdist URL instead of a package name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The artifact is fetched without index metadata, so its provenance and any advisory linkage are unknown at install time.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The artifact is fetched without index metadata, so its provenance and any advisory linkage are unknown at install time.
